---
name: Check symlinks before disk risk reports
description: Always verify output directories for symlinks before flagging disk space risks — output/ may symlink to data disk
type: feedback
---

Report disk risks only after confirming the actual physical device with `ls -la` or `stat`.

**Why:** Flagged disk overflow 3 times on provenance_weight_training because `output/models/` appeared to be on root partition (30GB). In reality, `output/` was a symlink to `/root/autodl-tmp/.../output` (250GB data disk). Wasted Director's time with 3 false alarms.

**How to apply:** Before any disk budget calculation, run `ls -la <output_dir>` or `stat <output_dir>` to check for symlinks. If symlinked, use the target device's `df` for capacity. Also check `df` on the actual file (not just the parent mount) to confirm which device it's on.
